name: Go
certifications: No vendor certification; assessed by capstone project
Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) for Go services on Kubernetes
Linux Foundation LFD259 Kubernetes for Developers (related)
tools: VS Code with the Go extension

beginner.summary: No Go experience assumed; some programming background helps. Participants learn the language, types, slices and maps, structs and interfaces, errors, packages, testing and a first look at goroutines, and finish with a working command-line tool.
prerequisites: Has written simple programs in any language
Can install software on their machine
outcomes: Write, build and run Go programs and modules
Use slices, maps, structs and interfaces idiomatically
Handle errors the Go way and write table-driven tests
Build a command-line tool that reads files and calls an HTTP API

days.topic: Go Setup, Modules and First Program
subtopics: What Go is used for and its design goals
Installing Go and checking go version
tools: VS Code with the Go extension
days.lab_task: Install Go, create a module, write a program that prints a formatted receipt, build binaries for Linux and Windows from one machine and run go fmt and go vet on the code.
days.deliverable: Module folder, two binaries and terminal output
checks: Prints three item lines and a total
Declare a variable and never use it
Compiler reports it as declared and not used

subtopics: var declarations and short declarations with :=
days.lab_task: Write a unit converter for temperatures, distances and weights, define units with iota constants and show one integer overflow and one rounding example with explanations.
days.deliverable: Converter source and notes on overflow and rounding
checks: Print an uninitialised int, string and bool

days.topic: Control Flow: if, for and switch
subtopics: The single for loop in three forms
Ranging over slices, maps and integers
switch with and without a condition
days.lab_task: Build a number guessing game that reads guesses from standard input, gives higher or lower hints, rejects non-numeric input and limits the player to seven attempts.
days.deliverable: Game source and a recorded session
checks: Guess correctly on the fourth try
Game ends and reveals the number
objectives: Write loops and conditions in Go

days.lab_task: Write a calculator package with functions that return a result and an error, a variadic sum, a closure that counts calls and a deferred function that logs how long each operation took.
days.deliverable: Package source and example program
checks: Returns an error, not a panic
Call the counter closure three times

subtopics: The slices package: Sort, Contains, Index
days.lab_task: Build a grade book that stores marks in slices, shows a bug caused by two slices sharing one backing array, fixes it with copy and sorts students by average with the slices package.
days.deliverable: Grade book source and a note explaining the shared-array bug
checks: Original slice changes, shown in output
objectives: Explain len, cap and backing arrays

subtopics: Checking for keys with comma ok
days.lab_task: Write a word frequency counter for a text file using a map, print the top ten words in a stable order, and count characters correctly for text containing non-English letters.
days.deliverable: Counter source and output for the sample text
checks: Top ten words match the answer file
Comma ok reports it is missing

days.lab_task: Model a library with Book and Member structs, methods to lend and return books, a constructor that validates input and an embedded Audit struct that records changes.
days.deliverable: Library package and example program
checks: Lend a book with a value receiver method
Change is lost, explained in a note
Create a Book with an empty title

subtopics: Escape to the heap in brief
days.lab_task: Write functions that update a bank account by value and by pointer, show the difference, trigger and fix a nil pointer panic, and check escape analysis output with -gcflags=-m.
days.deliverable: Source code, panic output and escape analysis output
checks: Update the balance through a value parameter
Call a method on a nil pointer
Panic shown, then guarded with a nil check
Shows which variable escapes to the heap
objectives: Explain stack and heap at a basic level

days.lab_task: Define a Notifier interface implemented by email, SMS and log notifiers, process them from one slice, add a Stringer to each and use a type switch to handle one special case.
days.deliverable: Notifier package and example program
checks: No change to the sending loop
Assert a Notifier to the wrong type with comma ok

days.lab_task: Add a transfer function that returns wrapped errors for insufficient funds and unknown accounts, check them with errors.Is and errors.As in the caller and recover from a deliberate panic in a worker.
days.deliverable: Source code and output for each error case
checks: Program continues and logs the panic
objectives: Inspect errors with Is and As
Use panic only for real bugs

subtopics: go get and go mod tidy
days.lab_task: Split the library code into model, store and cmd packages with an internal package, add a third-party module for colour output and show that internal code cannot be imported from outside.
days.deliverable: Restructured module and go.mod
checks: Import the internal package from another module
go.mod and go.sum list only used modules
Use an unexported function from another package

days.lab_task: Write a tool that reads every CSV file in a folder, validates rows, writes valid rows to one combined file and invalid rows with the reason to an errors file.
days.deliverable: Tool source, combined file and errors file
checks: Combined file has the 47 valid rows
Include a row with a missing price
Appears in the errors file with the reason
Point it at a missing folder

days.lab_task: Load an orders JSON file into structs, reject unknown fields, stream a large file with json.Decoder and write a summary with a custom money format.
days.deliverable: Program source and summary JSON
checks: Decode a file with an unknown field
Marshal an order with an empty note
objectives: Control JSON field names and output

subtopics: go test and test file names
days.lab_task: Write table-driven tests for the calculator and transfer functions covering normal and error cases, reach 90 percent coverage and add an example test that appears in the documentation.
days.deliverable: Test files and coverage report

days.lab_task: Check the status of 30 websites concurrently with goroutines and a WaitGroup, collect results through a channel, time out slow sites after two seconds and find a race with -race.
days.deliverable: Checker source, race detector output and timing comparison
checks: Reported as timed out after two seconds
Run with -race on the unsafe counter
Race detector reports the data race

days.lab_task: Write a client for a weather API with a timeout, an API key header, JSON decoding and clear errors for non-200 responses, tested against an httptest.Server.
days.deliverable: Client package and tests
checks: Return a 500 from the test server
Client returns an error with the status
Delay the test server five seconds
Client times out after three seconds

subtopics: ServeMux routing with methods and path values
days.lab_task: Build a notes HTTP API with list, get, create and delete routes using the standard ServeMux, JSON responses, a logging middleware and graceful shutdown on Ctrl+C.
days.deliverable: Server source and curl session
checks: POST a note with no title
objectives: Build HTTP servers with the standard library

days.topic: Command-Line Tools with flag and cobra
days.lab_task: Build a todo CLI with add, list, done and remove subcommands using cobra, storing tasks in a JSON file and returning proper exit codes.
days.deliverable: CLI source, release binaries and a usage session
checks: Run todo add "Buy milk" then todo list
Error on stderr and exit code 1

days.topic: Debugging Go and Code Quality Tools
subtopics: Breakpoints and stepping in VS Code
tools: VS Code with the Go extension
days.lab_task: Find and fix five planted bugs in a provided program using Delve, write a test that reproduces each bug first and get a clean golangci-lint run.
days.deliverable: Fixed code, new tests and lint output
checks: Run the new tests on the original code
Run them on the fixed code

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Website Monitor Command-Line Tool
days.lab_task: Build a CLI that reads a list of URLs from a JSON file, checks them concurrently with timeouts, records response times, writes a CSV report, exits non-zero when any site is down and has table-driven tests.
days.deliverable: Module, binaries, test report and a 10-minute demo
checks: Reported as down and exit code 1
All tests pass with no races
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one tool

intermediate.summary: For people who write basic Go. Covers concurrency patterns, context, generics, idiomatic design, web services, databases, testing, profiling and packaging services in containers.
prerequisites: Writes Go structs, interfaces and error handling confidently
Has used goroutines and channels in a small program
outcomes: Apply Go concurrency patterns with context and cancellation
Build production-style HTTP and gRPC services
Use databases, configuration and logging correctly
Test, benchmark and profile Go services

subtopics: Small interfaces defined by the consumer
Errors as part of the API
days.lab_task: Refactor a provided Java-style Go package with large interfaces, getters and setters into idiomatic Go with consumer-side interfaces, functional options and package documentation.
days.deliverable: Before and after code and a review note
checks: Create a client with no options
Run go doc on the package
Shows clear documentation for exported names

subtopics: When generics help and when interfaces are better
days.lab_task: Write generic Map, Filter and Reduce functions, a generic Set type and a generic cache with expiry, and replace three duplicated functions in a provided codebase.
days.deliverable: Generic package with tests and the refactored code
checks: Use the Set with strings and ints
Use a type that does not satisfy the constraint
Count lines before and after the refactor

days.topic: Concurrency Patterns: Pipelines, Fan-Out and Fan-In
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that reads 10,000 image paths, resizes them in a pool of eight workers, collects results and stops all workers when one fails, with no leaked goroutines.
days.deliverable: Pipeline source, timing results and leak test
checks: Run with one and eight workers
All workers stop and the error is returned
Check goroutines after completion with goleak

days.topic: Context for Cancellation, Deadlines and Request Values
subtopics: Passing context as the first parameter
days.lab_task: Add context to the HTTP server and the weather client so a client disconnect or a two-second deadline cancels downstream calls, and show that work stops when the request is cancelled.
days.deliverable: Updated code and logs showing cancellation
checks: Cancel the request with curl Ctrl+C
Downstream call is cancelled within 100 ms
Set a 2-second deadline with a slow upstream

subtopics: Deadlocks and how to spot them
days.lab_task: Build a thread-safe in-memory cache with RWMutex and expiry, initialise a config once with sync.Once, reuse buffers with sync.Pool and benchmark mutex and atomic counters.
days.deliverable: Cache source, benchmarks and race test output
checks: Run the cache tests with -race and 100 goroutines
Runtime reports all goroutines are asleep

subtopics: Stopping timers and tickers to avoid leaks
days.lab_task: Build a background scheduler that runs report jobs every minute with jitter, stops cleanly on cancellation, converts run times between zones and is tested with an injected fake clock.
days.deliverable: Scheduler package and tests
checks: Run the scheduler for five minutes
Five runs, each within the jitter window
Ticker stops and no more runs happen
Advance the fake clock by one hour in a test
objectives: Schedule work with timers and tickers

days.topic: Building REST APIs with chi or Gin
days.lab_task: Build a products REST API with chi or Gin including validation, consistent errors, pagination, CORS and OpenAPI docs, with handler tests for every route.
days.deliverable: API source, OpenAPI file and test report
checks: Create a product with a negative price

days.topic: Databases with database/sql, pgx and sqlc
days.lab_task: Store products in PostgreSQL with sqlc-generated queries, goose migrations, a stock transfer in a transaction and repository tests against a Docker database.
days.deliverable: Schema, migrations, generated code and tests
checks: Pass a name with SQL injection text
Fail halfway through a stock transfer

days.lab_task: Add validated configuration, JSON logs with request IDs, health and readiness endpoints and a shutdown that drains requests and stops background workers.
days.deliverable: Updated service and logs
checks: All log lines carry its request ID

days.topic: Testing with Mocks, Fakes and Integration Tests
days.lab_task: Test the order service with a fake repository and a mocked payment client, add golden-file tests for a report and integration tests that run only with an integration build tag.
days.deliverable: Test suite and test output for unit and integration runs
checks: Test confirms the order is not saved
Run go test without the tag

days.lab_task: Benchmark two implementations of a CSV parser, cut allocations by half, then fuzz the parser until it finds a crash, fix it and keep the failing input as a regression test.
days.deliverable: Benchmarks, benchstat comparison and fuzz corpus

days.lab_task: Load-test the products API, capture CPU and heap profiles, find the hot path and a goroutine leak, fix both and apply profile-guided optimisation.
days.deliverable: Profiles before and after and throughput results
checks: Check the goroutine profile after load
Goroutine count returns to baseline after the fix

subtopics: Generating code with protoc or buf
days.lab_task: Build an inventory gRPC service with unary and server-streaming methods, a logging interceptor and deadlines, tested in memory with bufconn.
days.deliverable: Proto files, service code and tests
checks: Call GetStock for an unknown item
Call with a 100 ms deadline on a slow method

days.topic: Authentication and Security for Go Services
days.lab_task: Add JWT login, role checks and rate limiting to the products API, serve it over TLS and scan dependencies with govulncheck.
days.deliverable: Security code, tests and scan output
checks: Delete a product as a normal user

days.topic: Working with Files, Streams and the io Interfaces
subtopics: Large file uploads without loading into memory
days.lab_task: Add a file upload endpoint that streams uploads to disk while computing a SHA-256 hash and compressing them, without holding the file in memory, and serve static files with embed.
days.deliverable: Upload handler and memory measurement
checks: Build the binary and delete the static folder

days.lab_task: Publish order events from the API and consume them in a stock service with acknowledgements, retries, a dead-letter topic and idempotent handling.
days.deliverable: Producer and consumer code and tests
checks: Ends up in the dead-letter topic

days.topic: Server-Rendered Web Pages with html/template and htmx
days.lab_task: Build an admin web page for products with html/template layouts, validated forms with CSRF protection, flash messages and htmx partial updates for search, all in one binary.
days.deliverable: Web application source and a recorded demo
checks: Enter a script tag in a product name
Submit the form without a CSRF token
Results update without a full page reload
objectives: Add interactivity without a front-end framework

days.lab_task: Build a distroless image under 20 MB for the products API with version information in the binary, run it with PostgreSQL in Docker Compose and scan it with Trivy.
days.deliverable: Dockerfile, Compose file, image size and scan report
checks: Returns the commit and build time

subtopics: go test with race and coverage in CI
Caching modules and the build cache
Matrix builds for Go versions and platforms
days.lab_task: Add a GitHub Actions pipeline that tests with race and coverage, lints, scans and builds on two Go versions, then releases binaries and images with GoReleaser on a tag.
days.deliverable: Workflow files and a release page
checks: Push code with a lint error
Binaries for three platforms are published

days.lab_task: Build an order service with a REST API, a gRPC stock client, PostgreSQL storage, events to a stock service, JWT security, full tests, profiling results and a CI pipeline, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, pipeline, test and profile reports and a 15-minute demo
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one service

advanced.summary: For working Go developers. Covers the runtime and scheduler, memory and GC tuning, high-performance code, advanced concurrency, distributed systems patterns, Kubernetes operators, observability and running Go services at scale.
prerequisites: Uses context, concurrency patterns and profiling
Has deployed Go services in containers
outcomes: Explain and tune the Go runtime, scheduler and garbage collector
Build reliable distributed services and Kubernetes controllers
Observe, secure and troubleshoot Go services in production

subtopics: The G, M and P model
Blocking system calls and network poller
days.lab_task: Run a CPU-heavy and an IO-heavy workload with different GOMAXPROCS settings inside a CPU-limited container, read scheduler traces and choose the right setting.
days.deliverable: Trace output, comparison table and recommendation
checks: Scheduler state is logged each second
Run in a 2-CPU container without setting GOMAXPROCS on an older Go

days.topic: Memory Management and Garbage Collector Tuning
days.lab_task: Run an allocation-heavy service under load with different GOGC and GOMEMLIMIT values, read GC traces and show the settings that keep it within a 512 MB container without being killed.
days.deliverable: GC traces, settings comparison and recommendation
checks: Set GOMEMLIMIT to 450MiB in a 512 MB container under load
Compare p99 latency across GOGC values

subtopics: Avoiding interface conversions in hot paths
days.lab_task: Optimise a JSON log parser so the hot path makes zero allocations per line, prove it with benchmarks and benchstat and check bounds-check elimination in the compiler output.
days.deliverable: Optimised parser, benchmarks and compiler output
checks: Hot loop has no bounds checks

days.topic: Advanced Concurrency and the Go Memory Model
days.lab_task: Protect an expensive upstream with singleflight so 1,000 concurrent identical requests make one call, limit total concurrency with a weighted semaphore and add rate limiting.
days.deliverable: Implementation, load test results and race test output
checks: Extra work waits and none is dropped

subtopics: Timeouts, retries and back-off with jitter
days.lab_task: Add an outbox table to the order service so events are never lost, idempotency keys to the API, retries with jitter and a circuit breaker around the payment call.
days.deliverable: Pattern implementations and failure tests
checks: Kill the service between database commit and publish
Event is still published after restart
Send the same POST twice with one idempotency key

days.topic: Event Sourcing and CQRS in Go
subtopics: Events as the source of truth
days.lab_task: Rebuild the account service with event sourcing: store events in PostgreSQL with version checks, project balances into a read model, rebuild it from scratch and upgrade an old event version.
days.deliverable: Event store, projections and tests
checks: Write to one stream from two writers at once
One fails with a version conflict
Drop and rebuild the read model
Load an aggregate with version 1 events

days.topic: Network Programming: TCP Servers and Custom Protocols
days.lab_task: Build a TCP key-value server with a length-prefixed protocol, deadlines, a limit of 1,000 connections and TLS, then load it with 10,000 clients and capture the traffic in Wireshark.
days.deliverable: Server and client source, load test output and packet capture
checks: Send a partial message and stop
Connection closed after the read deadline
Connections over the limit are refused cleanly

subtopics: Service configuration and retries in gRPC
Versioning protobuf schemas with buf breaking
days.lab_task: Expose the inventory service through gRPC-Gateway as REST, secure it with mTLS, add client-side load balancing across three instances and block a breaking schema change with buf.
days.deliverable: Service configuration, certificates setup and CI check
checks: Remove a field from the proto

days.topic: Observability: OpenTelemetry, Metrics and Structured Logs
subtopics: Trace context across HTTP, gRPC and messaging
days.lab_task: Instrument the order and inventory services with OpenTelemetry, follow one order through HTTP, gRPC and NATS in Jaeger, add RED metrics and continuous profiling, and build a dashboard.
days.deliverable: Instrumentation code, traces and dashboards
checks: All log lines for the request are found
Rate, errors and duration per route

subtopics: Testing with envtest or a fake client
days.lab_task: Write a Go program that watches Deployments with an informer and posts a message when a rollout fails, using a work queue, least-privilege RBAC and tests with a fake client.
days.deliverable: Program source, RBAC manifests and tests
checks: Program logs a clear forbidden error
objectives: Use the Kubernetes API from Go

days.lab_task: Build an operator for a Website custom resource that creates a Deployment, Service and Ingress, reports status conditions, cleans up with a finalizer and is tested with envtest.
days.deliverable: Operator repository, CRD and tests
checks: Deployment, Service and Ingress are created
Finalizer runs cleanup and the resource is removed

days.lab_task: Add a plugin system to the website monitor so new check types can be added as separate binaries over go-plugin and as WebAssembly modules, and compare the two approaches.
days.deliverable: Plugin host, two example plugins and a comparison note
checks: Add a new check plugin without rebuilding the host
Host keeps running and reports the failure
Plugin is stopped at the limit

subtopics: Supply chain: module checksums, SBOMs and signing
days.lab_task: Find and fix six planted vulnerabilities including SSRF and path traversal, add gosec and govulncheck to CI, generate an SBOM and sign the release image with cosign.
days.deliverable: Fixed code, scan reports, SBOM and signed image
checks: Make the service fetch an internal metadata URL
Verify the image signature with cosign

days.topic: Advanced Testing: Property-Based, Contract and Chaos Tests
subtopics: Contract tests for HTTP and gRPC
Load testing with k6 or vegeta
days.lab_task: Add property-based tests for the pricing logic, a contract test between order and inventory, fake-clock tests for expiry, and a chaos test that adds latency between services.
days.deliverable: Test suites and chaos test report
checks: Find or rule out edge cases with shrunk examples
Order service stays within its timeout budget

days.topic: Performance at Scale: Load Testing and Capacity Planning
days.lab_task: Find the saturation point of the order service, remove the top two bottlenecks with profiling and caching, and write a capacity plan for ten times the traffic.
days.deliverable: Load test reports, profiles and capacity plan
checks: Throughput at saturation at least doubled
Instance counts and limits are justified

subtopics: Resource requests and GOMAXPROCS and GOMEMLIMIT
days.lab_task: Deploy the services with Helm with probes, graceful shutdown, memory limits matched to GOMEMLIMIT and autoscaling, then run a rolling update under load with zero failed requests.
days.deliverable: Helm chart, load test result and scaling graph
checks: Roll out a new version under load
Set GOMEMLIMIT above the pod limit and load it
Participant diagnoses OOMKilled and fixes it

days.topic: Building CLIs and Developer Tools at Scale
subtopics: cobra and viper in large CLIs
Interactive prompts and TUIs with Bubble Tea
Distributing through Homebrew and package managers
days.lab_task: Turn the todo CLI into a team tool with config precedence, shell completion, an interactive TUI mode and Homebrew distribution with GoReleaser.
days.deliverable: CLI repository, release and install instructions
checks: Set an option in a flag, env var and config file
Flag wins, then env, then file
Press Tab after the command name
Install with brew from the tap

days.topic: Generating Code and Static Analysis Tools
days.lab_task: Write an analyzer that reports context.Context parameters that are not first, run it with golangci-lint, and generate typed enum String methods with go generate.
days.deliverable: Analyzer, generator and test output
checks: Run the analyzer on the sample code
Run go generate after adding an enum value

subtopics: Debugging in containers with Delve and ephemeral containers
days.lab_task: Work through three injected incidents (a goroutine leak, lock contention and memory growth), restore service, find the root causes with profiles and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident timelines, fixes and runbooks
checks: Leaking goroutine and code line identified
Write a runbook for memory growth

subtopics: Load test, demo and design defence
days.lab_task: Deliver a multi-service Go platform with gRPC and events, an outbox, an operator that manages tenant environments, tracing, profiling, signed images and a capacity-tested Kubernetes deployment, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repositories, operator, dashboards, load test report and a 20-minute demo
checks: Kill a service during a load test
No orders are lost and the system recovers
Follow one request in the tracing tool
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
